recommendation: Keep this source fix. No further core structural change is recommended for FHIR-32397; do not rename programStatus without a new work-group decision because current source and later Jira context use that child name.
issue_request: FHIR-32397 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that Immunization.programEligibility stop being an ambiguous repeating eligibility code by becoming a 0..* backbone element with required program and eligibility-value children.
initial_application: The Immunization StructureDefinition and examples were changed in 0a5b857, reverted in f324cb65 with broader immunization updates, and reapplied in 2ab10d9 with programEligibility as a BackboneElement containing required program and programStatus CodeableConcept children. The remaining stale surface was the active Library/library-fhir-model-definition source, whose model info still typed Immunization.programEligibility as List<CodeableConcept>.
additional_context: PHWG Immunization Innovations minutes in May 2022 support the backbone decision and note IG profiling flexibility for multiple programs. The 2020 Zulip thread raised the same 'where is the vaccination program?' ambiguity. Later Applied issue FHIR-53151 names programEligibility.programStatus, supporting retention of the current child name rather than renaming it to the Jira resolution's provisional .eligibility wording.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to add FHIR.Immunization.ProgramEligibility with program and programStatus CodeableConcept children and changed Immunization.programEligibility to List<FHIR.Immunization.ProgramEligibility>. Regenerated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so its Library.data attachment matches the content XML.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: added Immunization.ProgramEligibility ClassInfo and changed Immunization.programEligibility from List<CodeableConcept> to List<Immunization.ProgramEligibility>.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: regenerated the Library.data base64 attachment from the updated model-definition content XML.
